sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Leaving an abusive relationship is often the most dangerous time. This lesson explains why risk increases.

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: Abusive partners may escalate threats, stalking, or violence when they feel they are losing control.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.content: Parents learn strategies for safer planning, including timing, support networks, and documentation.

sections.title: Activity
sections.content: Reflect on any behaviours that escalated during past attempts to leave.

sections.title: Reflection
sections.content: Understanding risk helps parents make informed, safer decisions.
